blockers: Single-operator source: multi_operator_coverage = UNSUPPORTED. The Exchange supplies only Betfair's own exchange prices, so it cannot support governed multi-operator Consensus or an operator-diverse SpotBoard (DEC-013).

Data-use rights are not established by any retrieved primary source (all rights UNKNOWN, fail closed); commercial use reportedly requires a licensed vendor arrangement (a licence being required does not itself grant a right).
EPL competition, selection/runner (outcome) identifiers, timestamp semantics, historical availability, and request limits were not confirmable from accessible primary documentation.
unresolved_questions: Does a Betfair licensed-vendor / commercial arrangement permit ingesting, caching, retaining, publicly displaying, and/or redistributing exchange data? Requires reviewing the vendor licence (out of scope).
What are the selection/runner (selectionId) identifiers and the exchange price/state timestamps (e.g. lastMatchTime, publishTime)?
Is EPL match-winner data available on the exchange with a usable event identity, and what are the documented request/data limits?
